Definition
[nonsingular normalized Ricci-flow solution] Source: cao-zhu 1. Definition 5.3.1\group Nonsingular Three-Dimensional Solutions

A nonsingular solution\index{solution!nonsingular} of the Ricci flow is one where the solution of the normalized flow exists for all time $0\leq t<\infty $, and the curvature remains bounded $|Rm|\leq C<+\infty $ for all time with some constant $C$ independent of $t$.
